display.purpose: Balanced page titles and major section headings.

body.purpose: Readable interface, form, and content text.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Separate raised work areas from the midnight canvas.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Pair with the visible electric-blue keyboard focus outline.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Short control transitions and page entrance.

narrative.overview: A focused AI-native workspace with midnight surfaces and electric-blue and violet signals. Layered panels and quiet light support sustained work; motion clarifies real progress, selection, and content arrival. The product stays legible and familiar while company context guides creative work.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight surfaces establish the global Sparrow workspace.
Electric blue leads actions and focus; violet is a restrained secondary accent.
Company identities remain scoped to their selected workspace and content.
Clear hierarchy, visible focus, and responsive controls support daily work.
Motion is brief, purposeful, and reduced when requested.

rules.name: The Contextual Brand Rule
rules.body: A company logo, colors, and assets apply only to that company's workspace and content. Sparrow's palette must not replace the active company's theme variables.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use layered surface tones and soft, offset shadows for meaningful separation; reserve glow for a clear interaction or ambient accent.

rules.name: The Purposeful Motion Rule
rules.body: Motion clarifies navigation, progress, selection, or content arrival; essential state remains clear without animation.

dos: Use electric blue and violet as restrained global product accents.
Use the active project's client variables for company-context actions and selected states.
Keep semantic success, warning, and danger colors consistent.
Maintain visible keyboard focus, readable contrast, responsive layouts, and reduced-motion support.
Use short transitions and one restrained page entrance.
donts: Do not apply a selected company's identity as Sparrow's global identity.
Do not imply unsupported AI workflows, integrations, or payment functionality.
Avoid constant motion, excessive glow, gradient text, and decorative clutter.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate state.
Do not change authentication, generation, scheduling, or data contracts as a visual redesign.
